trends.name: A Pour-Over With a Twist: SOLO Spin Variable Flow Dripper
trends.buzz: Brian Quan tried out the SOLO Spin, a pour-over dripper with variable flow control, alongside 2025 US Barista Champion Kay Cheon.
trends.angle: New pour-over gear is always exciting — no matter your setup, there's room to play with flow and technique. Everyone's invited to nerd out over drippers.

trends.name: The Moka Bot: A PID-Controlled Moka Pot
trends.buzz: Lance Hedrick tests a custom-built PID controlled moka pot made by a fellow enthusiast — bringing precision temperature control to the classic stovetop brewer.
trends.angle: Moka pot lovers, this one's for you — someone engineered precision control into a beloved classic. Proof that every brew method has room to geek out, no gatekeeping on 'simple' gear.

trends.name: $100 Vintage Braun vs. $2,000 Setup — Blind Taste Test
trends.buzz: A blind taste test pits a $100 vintage 1980s Braun coffee maker against a $2,000 Fellow Aiden + Zerno Z1 setup, with surprising results about what really makes good drip coffee.
trends.angle: Big budget isn't the whole story — this is exactly our vibe. Great coffee can come from gear at any price point, so don't let anyone tell you you need to spend big to love your brew.

trends.name: A $300 Grinder Mod for Under $300
trends.buzz: A DIY mod combines a $150 A2 grinder with Pietro/Fiorenzato M Modal burrs, cutting the price of a sought-after filter grind profile in half.
trends.angle: Love this kind of community ingenuity — making great grind quality accessible is exactly the no-ego spirit we're about. Budget gear, big results.

trends.name: Fresh Coffee Toys Spotted at Cafe Show Seoul 2026
trends.buzz: Brian Quan toured Cafe Show Seoul 2026, highlighting new product reveals from brands like C64 grinder, Redxkey, and Lebrew.
trends.angle: Trade shows are where the next wave of gear gets its first look — fun to see what's bubbling up globally, wherever you are in your coffee journey.

trends.name: Cherry Love's US Debut: A Blind Cupping Box From Honduras
trends.buzz: Cherry Love launches Archetype, a limited-edition Honduras blind cupping box, with just 150 boxes available for $65 including shipping.
trends.angle: Blind cupping boxes are such a fun, approachable way to train your palate — no fancy vocabulary required, just curiosity and a cup.

trends.name: Gaggia Brera.LP: Budget Super-Auto Gets a Steam Wand Upgrade
trends.buzz: Gaggia's entry-level super-automatic Brera.LP adds Over-Ice brewing and more programmable drinks, with a real steam wand at a budget price point.
trends.angle: Super-autos get a bad rap sometimes, but upgrades like this make espresso-at-home more welcoming for folks who want convenience without sacrificing quality — zero judgment here.

trends.name: The Milk Foamer Face-Off
trends.buzz: James Hoffmann runs a big comparison of milk foamer options on the market, noting it's a crowded field with room for something new.
trends.angle: Milk frothing shouldn't feel intimidating — whichever foamer fits your kitchen and budget is the right one. Love seeing all the options laid out side by side.

trends.name: How Much Does Your Grinder Really Affect Espresso?
trends.buzz: Perfect Daily Grind breaks down how burr geometry, motor speed, and chamber design shape clarity, sweetness, and consistency in your espresso before water ever touches the puck.
trends.angle: Understanding your grinder is empowering, not gatekeeping — the more you know about why grind matters, the more confident you'll feel dialing in your own cup.

trends.name: Coffee Soup: A Clarity-Focused Espresso Style
trends.buzz: Brian Quan visits Big Sur in Shanghai to explore 'Coffee Soup' and Handbrew Simulation — two espresso styles built around body and clarity.
trends.angle: Love seeing baristas push espresso style in new directions — try it yourself at home and see what clarity-focused shots taste like to you, no 'right' way required.

trends.name: Best of 2026: High-End Grinder Roundup
trends.buzz: Whole Latte Love compares five premium espresso grinders from Eureka, Ceado, and Mahlkönig to help narrow down a home or café setup.
trends.angle: Whether you're grinder-curious or ready to upgrade, roundups like this make the premium tier less mysterious — explore at your own pace, there's no finish line in this hobby.

trends.name: Send In Your Holiday Coffees for a Podcast Cupping
trends.buzz: Sprudge is inviting listeners to submit their holiday coffee blends for a festive podcast cupping session.
trends.angle: Holiday coffee season is the perfect low-pressure way to get into cupping — grab whatever festive blend you've got and join the fun, everyone's palate counts.
